# External assets (Poly Haven, CC0)

All files here come from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) and are released under CC0 (public domain). The 1K sources were optimized for mobile: meshes decimated and meshopt-compressed with gltfpack, textures kept at 1K for the ground and 512 px for the plants.

| File | Source | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ground/aerial_grass_rock_* | aerial_grass_rock | meadows and grassland (albedo + normal) |
| ground/coast_sand_rocks_02_* | coast_sand_rocks_02 | jungle floor, rocky shorelines, rock breakup on terrain cliffs |
| ground/sand_03_* | sand_03 | beaches (albedo + normal) |
| rocks/boulder_01*.glb | boulder_01 | boulders, cliff faces, mineable stone; its texture is applied triplanar to all rocks, the sea arch, the cave, the cairn and distant islands |
| rocks/coast_rocks_02*.glb | coast_rocks_02 | half-submerged reef-rock shelves on rocky coasts (geometry only) |
| plants/anthurium_botany_01.glb | anthurium_botany_01 | large-leaf jungle understorey |
| plants/calathea_orbifolia_01.glb | calathea_orbifolia_01 | striped-leaf understorey |
| plants/weed_plant_02.glb | weed_plant_02 | low leafy ground cover |

The preview spheres in the ground-texture downloads are not used. Only their texture maps are shipped.
